mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_ref = #{outputRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

UPDATE agent_memory_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
